## Microsoft Defender for Endpoint (Preview)
---

A workbook to provide details about Microsoft Defender for Endpoint Advance Hunting to Overview & Analyse data brought through Microsoft Defender XDR Connector.

|Overview|Device|Network|File|
|--------|------|-------|----|
|MDE Tables Last Data Received|Source of the AV detections|Internet Connected Devices|FileActivityCount per Device|
|Daily Data Flow on MDE Tables|Get stats on ASR audit events|Count By Machine Group|Count by InitiatingProcessAccountUpn|
|Device Heartbeat|Get stats on ASR blocks|Count By Network Adaptor||
|Device where files are copied to USB Drive|AV Detections with USB Disk Drive|TimeSeries on Network Activity||
|Device Internet Connectivity Status |List files copied to USB mounted drives|Top 10 RemoteUrl accessed over TimeRange||
|Device Count by DNS Suffix ||Tor Clients||
|Device Microsoft Entra ID Join status ||||
|Device ClientVersion ||||

content.query:
union 
isfuzzy = true
(DeviceInfo | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated,*) | project TimeGenerated, Type= "DeviceInfo" | extend Description = "Machine information (including OS information)"),
(DeviceNetworkInfo | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated,*) | project TimeGenerated, Type="DeviceNetworkInfo"  | extend Description = "Network properties of machines"),
(DeviceProcessEvents | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated,*) | project TimeGenerated, Type="DeviceProcessEvents" | extend Description = "Process creation and related events"),
(DeviceNetworkEvents | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated,*) | project TimeGenerated, Type="DeviceNetworkEvents" | extend Description = "Network connection and related events"),
(DeviceFileEvents | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated,*) | project TimeGenerated, Type="DeviceFileEvents" | extend Description = "File creation, modification, and other file system events"),
(DeviceRegistryEvents | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated,*) | project TimeGenerated, Type="DeviceRegistryEvents" | extend Description = "Creation and modification of registry entries"),
(DeviceLogonEvents | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated,*) | project TimeGenerated, Type="DeviceLogonEvents" | extend Description = "Sign-ins and other authentication events"),
(DeviceImageLoadEvents | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated,*) | project TimeGenerated, Type="DeviceImageLoadEvents" | extend Description = "DLL loading events"),
(DeviceEvents | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated,*) | project TimeGenerated, Type="DeviceEvents" | extend Description = "Additional events types"),
(DeviceFileCertificateInfo | summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated,*) | project TimeGenerated, Type="DeviceFileCertificateInfo" | extend Description = "Certificate information of signed files)")
| extend ["Last Log Received At (Local Time)"] = TimeGenerated
| project Type, Description, ["Last Log Received At (Local Time)"]
content.title: MDE Tables Last Data Received based on {TimeRange}
Daily Data Flow on MDE Tables over {TimeRange}

content.query:
DeviceInfo 
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated,*) by DeviceId
| extend ParsedFields=parse_json(LoggedOnUsers)[0]
| extend DurationAtLeast= format_timespan(now()-TimeGenerated,'dd:hh:mm:ss')
| project DurationAtLeast,TimeGenerated,DeviceName,DomainName=ParsedFields.DomainName,UserName=ParsedFields.UserName
| order by DurationAtLeast asc
content.title: Device Heartbeat from TimeTange {TimeRange}

content.query:
let UsbDriveMount = DeviceEvents
| where ActionType=="UsbDriveMounted"
| extend ParsedFields=parse_json(AdditionalFields)
| project DeviceId, DeviceName, DriveLetter=ParsedFields.DriveLetter, MountTime=Timestamp,
ProductName=ParsedFields.ProductName,SerialNumber=ParsedFields.SerialNumber,Manufacturer=ParsedFields.Manufacturer
| order by DeviceId asc, MountTime desc;
let FileCreation = DeviceFileEvents
| where InitiatingProcessAccountName != "system"
| where ActionType == "FileCreated"
| where FolderPath !startswith "C:\\"
| where FolderPath !startswith "\\"
| project ReportId,DeviceId,InitiatingProcessAccountDomain,
InitiatingProcessAccountName,InitiatingProcessAccountUpn,
FileName, FolderPath, SHA256, Timestamp, SensitivityLabel, IsAzureInfoProtectionApplied
| order by DeviceId asc, Timestamp desc;
FileCreation | lookup kind=inner (UsbDriveMount) on DeviceId
| where FolderPath startswith DriveLetter
| where Timestamp >= MountTime
| partition by ReportId ( top 1 by MountTime )
| order by DeviceId asc, Timestamp desc
| summarize FileCount = count() by DeviceName
| order by FileCount desc
content.title: Device where files are copied to USB Drive from TimeTange {TimeRange}

content.query:
DeviceNetworkInfo
| extend ConnectedNetworks = todynamic(tostring(ConnectedNetworks)) 
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated,*) by DeviceId
| mvexpand ConnectedNetworks
| summarize count() by InternetConnectivity = coalesce(tostring(ConnectedNetworks.IsConnectedToInternet), "Unknown")
content.title: Device Internet Connectivity Status from TimeTange {TimeRange}

content.query:
DeviceInfo
| where isnotempty(OSPlatform)
| summarize arg_max(Timestamp, DeviceName) by DeviceId
| extend DeviceMachineName = split(DeviceName, '.')[0]
| extend DeviceDomain = substring(DeviceName, strlen(DeviceMachineName) + 1, strlen(DeviceName) - strlen(DeviceMachineName) - 1)
| summarize count() by DeviceDomain = coalesce(DeviceDomain, "No DNS suffix")
content.title: Device Count by DNS Suffix

content.query:
DeviceInfo
| where isnotempty(OSPlatform)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceId
| summarize count() by EntraIDJoinStatus = coalesce(tostring(IsAzureADJoined), "Unknown")
content.title: Device EntraID Join status

content.query:
DeviceInfo
| where isnotempty(OSPlatform)
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by DeviceId
| summarize count() by ClientVersion
content.title: Device ClientVersion
Source of the AV detections for {TimeRange}

content.query:
DeviceEvents
| where ActionType startswith "Asr" and ActionType endswith "Audited"
// Count total stats - count events and machines per rule
| summarize EventCount=count(), MachinesCount=dcount(DeviceId) by ActionType
content.title: Get stats on ASR audit events - count events and machines per rule for {TimeRange}

content.query:
DeviceEvents
| where ActionType startswith "Asr" and ActionType endswith "Blocked"
// Count total stats - count events and machines per rule
| summarize EventCount=count(), MachinesCount=dcount(DeviceId) by ActionType
content.title: Get stats on ASR blocks - count events and machines per rule for {TimeRange}

content.query:
DeviceNetworkInfo
| extend ConnectedNetworks = todynamic(tostring(ConnectedNetworks)) 
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated,*) by DeviceId
| mv-apply ConnectedNetworks on 
(
where ConnectedNetworks.IsConnectedToInternet == true
)
| project DeviceName, DefaultGateways, IPv4Dhcp, IPv6Dhcp,MacAddress,MachineGroup, ConnectedNetworks.IsConnectedToInternet
content.title: Internet Connected Devices for {TimeRange}

content.query:
DeviceNetworkInfo
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated,*) by DeviceId
| summarize count() by MachineGroup
content.title: Count By Machine Group for {TimeRange}

content.query:
DeviceNetworkInfo
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated,*) by DeviceId
| summarize count() by NetworkAdapterType, NetworkAdapterStatus
content.title: Count By Network Adaptor

content.query:
DeviceNetworkEvents
| summarize count() by DeviceName, DeviceId,bin( TimeGenerated,5m)
content.title: TimeSeries on Network Activity for {TimeRange}

content.query:
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where isnotempty(RemoteUrl)
| summarize count() by RemoteUrl
| order by count_ desc
| limit 10
content.title: Top 10 RemoteUrl accessed over TimeRange {TimeRange}

| summarize FileActivityCount = count() by DeviceName
content.title: FileActivityCount per Device for {TimeRange}

| summarize count() by InitiatingProcessAccountUpn = coalesce(InitiatingProcessAccountUpn, "No UPN")
